requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3899-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3899-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-1594-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-1594-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-3536-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3536-4779-5131--202.description:

Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat from step 2

3446-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1479-3756-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1322-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3903-3958-7666.description:
Donate Moderation to an opponent.
Cast Knowledge Pool by paying {6}.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

Repeat each combat phase.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station and Surrak and Goreclaw trigger.
Resolve the Surrak and Goreclaw trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat

397-1636-3868.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

38-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-1517-4935.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, copying instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Time Stretch.
Resolve both Time Stretches, causing you to get four extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, targeting The Mirari Conjecture and causing you to pay {4}{U} to cast it from your graveyard.
The Mirari Conjecture enters with a lore counter on it, triggering its first chapter ability, returning an instant card from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your third extra turn and repeat from step 1.
957-1517-4935.notes: During the first extra turn, you will not be able to cast other spells, but you can during the remaining turns as desired.

4294-5220-5256.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from Step 3, ensure that you do not target yourself.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

147-2921-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

512-1805-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

1671-4572-4826-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When Kalain enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.

2724-3194-3335.notablePrerequisites: Lady Sun does not have summoning sickness.
2724-3194-3335.description:

2239-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Ardent Elementalist.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3529-3680-4231.notablePrerequisites:

When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

618-957-2187.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1271-3212-4084.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Part the Waterveil on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Part the Waterveil, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {2}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
